excerpt.zh:
队员们清理了[Root.GetName]上的雨林后，有了惊人的发现——在丛林的深处，茂密的植被覆盖下有一座巨大的外星空间站。他们的建筑学令人震惊，建造技术远远领先于我们，简直是一件艺术品。

空间站似乎是坠落在行星表面，多亏其非同寻常的防护机能才挺过了撞击，我们的科学家迫切想要调查这个空间站。遗憾的是如果进行考古发掘，则在工作完成前我们将无法利用这块土地。

texts.en:
The crew clearing the jungle on [Root.GetName] has made a spectacular discovery - deep within the forest, overgrown and obscured by the lush plant life is a colossal alien space station. Architecturally stunning and built with technology far superior to our own, it is a true work of art.

The station appears to have crashed to the surface, surviving the impact thanks to its unusual shielding capacities, which our scientists are now eager to examine. Regrettably an archaeological excavation would prevent us from working the land until its completion.

label.zh: 这片土地有更好的用处。
label.en: There are better uses for this land.

texts.zh: 队员们清理了[Root.GetName] 上的雨林后，无意中有了一个不寻常的发现，在一丛古老枯萎的树林下覆盖着一处[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] 似乎从未涉足的地方，九个巨型雕像，在其下的景物上投下了冰冷而高大的阴影。这些雕像带有羽翼而又通体苍白，散发着来自异世界的气质。它们并不像这颗行星上的任何生命形式。或许它们是依某种早被遗忘的神祗或偶像的形象建造的。
texts.en: The crew clearing the jungle on [Root.GetName] has stumbled upon an unusual find. Previously obscured deep within a tangle of old withered trees, where it would seem no [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] has ventured before, are nine massive statues, casting dark, tall shadows over the landscape. Winged and pale they exude an aura of otherworldliness. Perhaps they were created in the image of a deity or idol that has since passed into oblivion. They do not resemble any lifeforms on this planet.

Perhaps they were created in the image of a deity or idol that has since passed into oblivion. They do not resemble any lifeforms on this planet.
